capabilities: Run agent CLIs in sidebar terminal tabs
Open an agent in a folder via context menu
Send file paths and selections to the agent
Switch between CLI backends (Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, etc.)
Launch agents in projects outside the vault
extras: Listing carries the notice: "This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff." Mobile platforms are not supported; the README points to the Claude Anywhere plugin for that. Windows users need extra setup (pywinpty, shell choice between cmd.exe and WSL).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run terminal-based coding agent CLIs, so using Claude Code or similar tools means leaving the app.

relations.evidence: Run Claude Code (and other agent CLIs) in your Obsidian sidebar.
Built by Derek Larson - Pairs with Delegate commands
Want to use it on iOS or Android? See Claude Anywhere.

requires.name: an agent CLI (Claude Code by default) and Python 3

summary: Sidebar panel that runs AI agent CLIs like Claude Code in embedded terminal tabs inside Obsidian, with folder context and multi-backend support.
